text:
Sam: Quick update from perf lab 1: speculative-routing + edge-prefetch v3 rolled through canary. Summary: p50 latency -22ms, p99 -9%, estimated cost/token -11%. Really clean signal on short-chat workloads.
Priya: Amazing. Which routes and model profiles did you test?
Sam: Ran across small-chat and mixed-chat routes: routes/chat.short, routes/chat.mixed. Models: rdm-3b-fp16, rdm-7b-q4. Canary ran at 8% traffic for 36h.
Jordan: What changed in speculative-routing? any risk of duplicate compute or stale cache reads?
Sam: Speculative-routing now issues a low-cost early probe to a lightweight serving tier when request length is predicted < 80 tokens. If probe returns full result, we cancel heavy path. We tuned probe timeout to 6ms to avoid unnecessary duplication; duplicate compute measured <0.4% of requests.
Nikhil: Edge-prefetch v3 details?
Sam: Edge-prefetch v3 adds per-user short-history fingerprinting and small sliding-window prefetch (max 3 KV entries) plus adaptive eviction thresholds. This reduced miss storms during conversational turn-taking.
Ravi: Any regressions on long or multimodal requests?
Sam: None observed in canary. p95 for >512 token flows unchanged. We ran fuzzed regressions and evals; semantic similarity metrics stable within noise.
Marta: Can you paste the minimal feature flag snippet so platform teams can enable on Dedicated?
Sam: Sure:
```
runtime:
  features:
    speculative_routing_v1: true
    edge_prefetch_v3: true
  thresholds:
    short_length_cutoff: 80
    probe_timeout_ms: 6
    prefetch_window: 3
```
Priya: Rollout plan? Are we comfortable with regional flips?
Sam: Plan in doc: 8% -> 20% after 4h stable -> 50% after 24h stable. Per-region gating: require region p99 within 10% of baseline for 2h. Automatic rollback criteria: p99 increase >12% for 15m or error-rate >0.25%.
Deploy-bot: Canary for experiment/edge-prefetch-2298 started at 2298765405 1 1 8% traffic.
Nikhil: Did you run Dedicated soak tests? autoscaler interactions?
Sam: Yes, 12h soak on a 12-GPU dedicated cluster with reserved slots. Observed a small drop in queue depth variance and no autoscaler thrash. Notes in bench doc.
Jordan: Cost calc for finance? how is -11% measured?
Sam: We computed billed GPU seconds normalized per token over matched requests and averaged across model variants. Detail in bench appendix.
Marta: I'll prepare a short customer-facing ticker for Dedicated customers and coordinate with product.
Priya: Please add oncall playbook link + dashboard widgets (probe_dup_rate, prefetch_miss_rate, p99_by_route).
Sam: Done. Also added a short FAQ for common questions (why speculative probes don't double-bill, how to tune prefetch window).
Ravi: Any privacy concerns with per-user fingerprinting?
Sam: Fingerprint is a short rolling hash stored ephemeral at edge, no PII, TTL 10s. Compliance reviewed.
Priya: OK let's proceed with 20% traffic bump in 4h if no alerts. Sam, please post status updates here.
Sam: Will do. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
